name: Minda Corporation Ltd
_note: Fact base for the Minda Corporation (Spark Minda) initiation, as of 30-Sep-2026 (Q1FY27 basis). Rupees in crore unless stated; AR figures converted from Rs million. Every item carries its source; all sources published on or before 30-Sep-2026.

ar26.t: Annual Report FY2025-26 (consolidated notes 2.4, 2.16-2.17, 2.49; Annexure III; corporate governance report)

ar24.t: Annual Report FY2023-24 (note 2.48: Pricol stake sale through OCI)

warrants.t: Board approval of 76.5 lakh warrants to Minda Capital at Rs550 (Autocar Pro)

pricol.t: Minda Corp exits Pricol, sells 15.7% for Rs658 cr (Autocar Pro / company filing)

profile.what: Flagship of the Spark Minda group (Ashok Minda family), separate from Uno Minda (N.K. Minda) since the 2012 family split. Tier-1 maker of wiring harnesses, instrument clusters, vehicle-access and security systems (locks, handles, immobilisers), aluminium die castings, plastics and EV electronics; plus a 49% stake in Flash Electronics (EV and two-wheeler power electronics, motors). 42 plants, 23,000+ people, 335+ patents filed.

verticals.mechatronics: Mechatronics, Aftermarket and Others: vehicle access (incl. Minda Vast from FY27), die casting, aftermarket, EV systems
verticals.ics: Information and Connected Systems: wiring harness (incl. HV harness, connectors), instrument clusters (TFT), sensors, telematics

profile.groupRevenueSrc: q1deck p2 (includes associates and JVs: Flash, Minda Vast, Furukawa Minda)
profile.evShare: EV ~10% of consolidated revenue (+40% yoy), ~30% of Flash revenue (+90%), ~14% at group level (q1call)
profile.orderBook: Lifetime orders won in FY26 >Rs10,000 cr (~20% exports); Rs2,500 cr in Q1FY27 (EV >15%) (q4call, q1call)

shares.src: ar26 notes 2.16.8 and 2.17.9 (Rs105.2 cr received); board approval 28-Mar-2025 (warrants source); AR26 directors' report: allotment 2-Jun-2025

associatesFY26.src: q4call (CFO: Flash ~Rs70 cr, Furukawa ~Rs8 cr, Vast ~Rs5 cr; EVQ nil)

flash.guidance: 20-24% revenue growth; 16-17% long-term EBITDA margin; back-to-back commodity pass-through (q1call)
flash.src: ar25 (Rs1,372 cr for 49% incl. subsidiaries); ar26 notes 2.4 and 2.49; q4deck p10; q1deck p8; q1call

vast.why: change in the shareholders' agreement with VAST gave control (q4call)
vast.kit: Rs8,000-13,000 per car today; could double with new products (q1call)
vast.src: q4call; q1call; q1deck p5, p10; ar26 notes 2.4 and 2.49

otherJVs: Switches for 2W and cars; ~Rs150 cr initial investment; SOP Q4FY27; lifetime orders >Rs1,000 cr; Rs650 cr revenue target by 2030
Sunroofs and power tailgates (HCMF Taiwan); SOP Q2FY27; lifetime order ~Rs350 cr; Rs500 cr revenue target by 2030
Axial-flux motors, motor controllers, water pumps (Turntide, UK); formed 9-Mar-2026; controller SOP Oct-Nov 2026
Wiring harness for Japanese car makers

guidance.marginFY27: 11.5-12% for the rest of FY27 (CFO, q1call); 12.5% EBITDA margin by FY30 (Vision 2030)
guidance.growth: At least 1.5x industry growth (q4call); ~19-20% a year needed for Vision 2030
guidance.vision2030: Group revenue Rs17,500 cr+ by FY30 (includes Flash and inorganic moves; q4call), EBITDA margin >12.5%, ROCE >25%, debt-equity 0.3x, exports Rs1,500 cr (FY25 Rs420 cr), PV share 25% (FY25 14%) (v2030 p28-35)
guidance.capexFY27: ~Rs400-450 cr (q4call); ~Rs400 cr (q1call). Vision: ~Rs2,000 cr over five years (v2030 p28, p33)

leverage.ratings: CRISIL AA/Stable, A1+; India Ratings AA/Stable
leverage.src: q4deck p11 (debt excl. leases; ROCE excludes investments and JV profit; net debt/EBITDA includes 49% of Flash EBITDA)

oneOffs.why: FY22: Rs33 cr exceptional gain and a low (12%) tax rate; FY23: one-time tax benefit from the write-off of the KTSN (Germany) investment allowed as a tax deduction (ar24 note), tax rate 1%. FY24: Pricol stake (15.7%, Rs658 cr, 17-Jan-2024) sold through OCI, no P&L gain (ar24 note 2.48, Rs239 cr in OCI). Q1FY27: Rs124 cr (Rs106 cr after tax) fair-value gain on consolidating Minda Vast.
oneOffs.src: q4fy24deck p5 (normalised PAT); v2030 p27 (FY23 PAT adjusted for one-time tax benefit and exceptional item); ar24 note 2.48; q1deck p5

history: Minda family split: Ashok Minda runs Minda Corp (Spark Minda); N.K. Minda runs Minda Industries (now Uno Minda)
Minda KTSN (Germany) plastics unit enters insolvency and is written off; the write-off is later claimed as a tax deduction (FY23 tax rate 1%)
Exit from Pricol: 15.7% sold for Rs658 cr (bought at ~Rs400 cr), gain through OCI
49% of Flash Electronics bought for Rs1,372 cr, largely debt-funded (gross debt Rs348 cr to Rs1,344 cr)
76.5 lakh warrants allotted to promoter Minda Capital at Rs550 (25% paid)
Vision 2030: Rs17,500 cr+ revenue, >12.5% margin, >25% ROCE
JVs with Toyodenso (switches, 60%), HCMF (sunroofs, 50%), Turntide (EV motors, 49%)
Minda Vast consolidated (SHA change); Rs124 cr fair-value gain in Q1FY27
historySrc: Screener.in company note; ar24-ar26; q4deck; q1deck; Autocar Pro (Pricol, warrants)
management: Group CFO and President, Finance & Strategy, from 5-Feb-2026 (Vinod Raheja resigned 30-Nov-2025)

auditor: S R Batliboi & Co. LLP (EY network); audit-trail exceptions noted for some software at the company and some JVs/associates (ar26 note 2.48)
dividendPolicy: Rs1.40 a share for FY26 (9% payout); payout 9-15% since FY22
